data.one_liner: A lightweight, customizable framework to create presentations in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: A framework for building presentations and slide decks as Flutter applications. It supports features like Navigator 2.0 deep linking, multiple steps per slide, presenter views, custom themes, and built-in templates.
use_when: You want to build slide presentations using Flutter widgets and code.
You need deep linking per slide and presenter view controls.
avoid_when: You are building a standard mobile application UI.
You need a WYSIWYG graphical presentation editor instead of a code-based one.
strengths: Built with Flutter, allowing any widget to be used inside slides.
Supports multiple steps per slide and global configuration overrides.
Includes built-in presenter view and localization support.
weaknesses: Limited to presentation and slide deck use cases.
Requires code editing to change presentation content.
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_deck to pubspec.yaml and define FlutterDeckApp with slides.
